title: Remote VTEP Unreachable — dc1-leaf2a/2b VTEP 10.255.1.5
symptom: VTEP 10.255.1.5 unreachable from dc1-leaf1a. VXLAN tunnels to leaf2 pair are down. 0 EVPN prefixes from AS 65102.
root_cause: Both uplinks on dc1-leaf2a (Et1 to spine1, Et2 to spine2) are shutdown, making VTEP 10.255.1.5 unreachable.
fix_command:
interface Ethernet1
no shutdown
interface Ethernet2
no shutdown
